intent: Key frame 90 loses the FU-A fragment that ends its IDR and carries the marker, never repaired. The jitter buffer drops the frame's other 6 packets, and the writer drops frames 90-179 until key frame 180. The track buffer asks 200-240 ms after frame 91 reveals the gap, and once a second while no key frame follows it: 3 requests. Key frame 180's SPS ends the asking. RED when the track buffer's key frame hint misses H.264 key frames: it asks again 1 s after key frame 180 (4 requests).
